name: How does laminate flooring compare to engineered hardwood in terms of installation and cost?

mainEntity.name: How does laminate flooring compare to engineered hardwood in terms of installation and cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Laminate flooring typically has a simpler click-lock installation system, making it generally quicker and less labor-intensive to install than engineered hardwood, which often requires gluing, nailing, or floating. Regarding cost, laminate usually has a lower material price point and often lower installation costs. Engineered hardwood, while more expensive, offers a real wood veneer that can be refinished, whereas laminate cannot. Both offer durable surfaces, but laminate excels in moisture resistance for areas like kitchens, while engineered wood provides a natural wood aesthetic.
acceptedAnswer.description: Laminate installation is generally simpler and less costly than engineered hardwood. Laminate is more moisture-resistant, while engineered hardwood offers a refinishable real wood surface.
